description: Bash's own builtins, as a script uses them: options, statuses and error paths.

cases.name: builtin: file tests on an empty path
cases.script: [ -e '' ] || echo e; [[ -d '' ]] || echo d; test -f '' || echo f

cases.name: builtin: alias needs expand_aliases
cases.script:
alias hi='echo hello'
hi 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: alias expands on a later line
cases.script:
shopt -s expand_aliases
alias hi='echo hello'
hi there

cases.name: builtin: alias on the same line does not expand
cases.script: shopt -s expand_aliases; alias hi='echo hello'; hi 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: alias listing and unalias
cases.script: alias a='echo a' b='echo b'; alias; unalias a; alias; unalias nosuch; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: alias -p and missing alias
cases.script: alias x='ls -l'; alias -p; alias nosuch; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: builtin runs the builtin
cases.script: echo() { printf 'fn\n'; }; echo x; builtin echo y; builtin nosuch; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: command bypasses functions
cases.script: ls() { echo fn; }; ls; command -v ls >/dev/null && echo found; command echo direct

cases.name: builtin: command -v and -V
cases.script: f() { :; }; command -v f cd echo; command -V f 2>&1 | head -n 1

cases.name: builtin: type -t forms
cases.script: f() { :; }; alias a=b; type -t f cd if a nosuch; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: type output
cases.script: type cd; type if; f() { echo x; }; type f

cases.name: builtin: hash with no path
cases.script: hash; echo status=$?; hash -r; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: enable lists and disables
cases.script: enable -n echo; echo hi 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?; enable echo; echo back

stderr.text: bash: enable -n is unsupported in bash-tool

expected.reason: refused (runtime-gaps): bash-tool refuses a feature it does not implement, up front when the script names it

cases.name: builtin: caller outside a function
cases.script: caller; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: caller inside a function
cases.script: f() { caller 0 >/dev/null; echo status=$?; }; f

cases.name: builtin: eval builds commands
cases.script: x='echo'; y='hi there'; eval "$x \"$y\""; eval 'a=1; b=2'; echo $((a+b))

cases.name: builtin: eval syntax error
cases.script: eval 'if'; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: eval status and exit
cases.script: eval 'false'; echo status=$?; eval 'exit 3'; echo not-reached

cases.name: builtin: source a file with arguments
cases.script: printf 'echo "sourced $1 $#"; v=set\n' >/tmp/lib.sh; source /tmp/lib.sh a b; echo $v; . /tmp/lib.sh

cases.name: builtin: source return status
cases.script: printf 'return 4\necho no\n' >/tmp/r.sh; . /tmp/r.sh; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: source a missing file
cases.script: source /tmp/nosuch.sh; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: continue and break levels
cases.script: for i in 1 2 3; do for j in a b c; do [ $j = b ] && continue 2; [ $i = 3 ] && break 2; echo $i$j; done; done; echo end

cases.name: builtin: continue outside a loop
cases.script: continue; echo status=$?; break; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: break with a bad count
cases.script: for i in 1 2; do break 0; done; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: declare -p forms
cases.script: declare -i n=5; declare -a a=(1 2); declare -A m=([k]=v); declare -r r=1; declare -x e=2; declare -p n a m r e

cases.name: builtin: declare -i evaluates
cases.script: declare -i n; n=2+3*4; echo $n; n+=1; echo $n; n=abc; echo $n

cases.name: builtin: declare -l and -u
cases.script: declare -l lo=HeLLo; declare -u up=HeLLo; echo $lo $up; lo=AGAIN; echo $lo

cases.name: builtin: declare -f and -F
cases.script: f() { echo body; }; g() { :; }; declare -F; declare -f f

cases.name: builtin: declare -g inside a function
cases.script: f() { declare -g G=global; declare L=local; }; f; echo "[$G] [${L-unset}]"

cases.name: builtin: typeset is declare
cases.script: typeset -i t=1+1; echo $t; typeset -p t

cases.name: builtin: local outside a function
cases.script: local x=1; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: local scoping is dynamic
cases.script: x=global; inner() { echo $x; }; outer() { local x=outer; inner; }; outer; echo $x

cases.name: builtin: local -
cases.script: f() { local -; set -f; echo *; }; f; set -o | grep -E '^noglob'

cases.name: builtin: readonly blocks assignment
cases.script: readonly r=1; r=2; echo status=$?; echo $r; unset r; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: readonly -p
cases.script: readonly a=1 b; readonly -p | grep -E ' (a|b)'

cases.name: builtin: pushd popd dirs
cases.script: cd /tmp; mkdir -p a b; pushd a >/dev/null; pushd /tmp/b; dirs; popd >/dev/null; pwd; popd; dirs -c; dirs

cases.name: builtin: popd on an empty stack
cases.script: popd; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: pushd to a missing directory
cases.script: pushd /nope; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: disown a job
cases.script: sleep 0.05 & disown; jobs | wc -l; wait; echo status=$?; sleep 0.2

cases.name: builtin: disown with no job
cases.script: disown %5; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: times
cases.script: times >/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: getopts basic
cases.script: set -- -a -b val -c rest; while getopts ab:c o; do echo "$o ${OPTARG-}"; done; shift $((OPTIND-1)); echo "rest=$*"

cases.name: builtin: getopts clustered and attached
cases.script: set -- -abval -c; while getopts ab:c o; do echo "$o ${OPTARG-}"; done; echo OPTIND=$OPTIND

cases.name: builtin: getopts unknown option
cases.script: set -- -x; while getopts ab o; do echo "got $o"; done; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: getopts silent mode
cases.script: set -- -x -b; while getopts :ab: o; do echo "$o ${OPTARG-}"; done

cases.name: builtin: getopts missing argument
cases.script: set -- -b; while getopts b: o; do echo "got $o"; done

cases.name: builtin: getopts in a function
cases.script: f() { local OPTIND o; while getopts n: o "$@"; do echo "$o=$OPTARG"; done; }; f -n 1; f -n 2

cases.name: builtin: getopts stops at --
cases.script: set -- -a -- -b; while getopts ab o; do echo $o; done; shift $((OPTIND-1)); echo "$@"

cases.name: builtin: let arithmetic and status
cases.script: let a=2*3 b=a+1; echo $a $b; let 0; echo status=$?; let 'c = 1 + 1'; echo $c

cases.name: builtin: readarray options
cases.script:
printf 'a
b
c
d
' >/tmp/f; readarray -t -s 1 -n 2 arr </tmp/f; declare -p arr; mapfile -t -O 5 arr </tmp/f; echo ${#arr[@]} ${arr[5]}

cases.name: builtin: mapfile with a delimiter
cases.script: printf 'a,b,c' | { mapfile -d , -t parts; printf '[%s]' "${parts[@]}"; echo; }

cases.name: builtin: shift counts
cases.script: set -- a b c d; shift; echo "$*"; shift 2; echo "$*"; shift 5; echo status=$? "$*"

cases.name: builtin: set -- and positional count
cases.script: set -- 'a b' c; echo $#; for x in "$@"; do echo "[$x]"; done; set --; echo $#

cases.name: builtin: echo options
cases.script: echo -n no-newline; echo; echo -e 'a\tb\x41\0101'; echo -E 'raw\t'; echo -- -n

cases.name: builtin: printf -v
cases.script: printf -v out '%05d|%-4s|' 42 ab; echo "$out"; printf -v 'arr[1]' '%s' x; echo ${arr[1]}

cases.name: builtin: printf reuses its format
cases.script:
printf '%s=%s
' a 1 b 2 c; printf '%b
' 'x	y'; printf '%q
' 'a b' "it's"

cases.name: builtin: printf errors
cases.script: printf '%d\n' 1.5; echo status=$?; printf '%z'; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: read splits on IFS
cases.script: echo 'a b  c d' | { read x y z; echo "[$x][$y][$z]"; }; echo 'a:b:c' | { IFS=: read -r x y; echo "[$x][$y]"; }

cases.name: builtin: read -r and backslashes
cases.script: printf 'a\\b\n' | { read v; echo "$v"; }; printf 'a\\b\n' | { read -r v; echo "$v"; }

cases.name: builtin: read -a -d -n -N
cases.script: echo 'x y z' | { read -a arr; echo ${#arr[@]} ${arr[2]}; }; printf 'ab;cd' | { read -d ';' v; echo $v; }; echo abcdef | { read -n 3 v; echo $v; }; printf 'a\nb' | { read -N 3 v; printf '[%s]\n' "$v"; }

cases.name: builtin: read at EOF
cases.script: printf 'last' | { read v; echo status=$? v=$v; }; : | { read v; echo status=$?; }

cases.name: builtin: while read loop
cases.script:
printf '1 a
2 b
3 c
' | while read -r n l; do echo "$l$n"; done

cases.name: builtin: read -p to stderr
cases.script: echo x | { read -p 'prompt: ' v 2>/dev/null; echo $v; }

cases.name: builtin: read -u from a descriptor
cases.script: echo from3 >/tmp/f; exec 3</tmp/f; read -u 3 v; echo $v; exec 3<&-

cases.name: builtin: set -o listing
cases.script: set -o | grep -E '^(errexit|nounset|pipefail|noglob) '

cases.name: builtin: set +o round trip
cases.script: set -e -u; set +o | grep -E 'errexit|nounset'

cases.name: builtin: set with a bad option
cases.script: set -o nosuchoption; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: shopt query forms
cases.script: shopt -q extglob; echo status=$?; shopt -s nullglob; shopt nullglob; shopt -p nullglob; shopt -u nullglob; shopt -q nullglob; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: shopt unknown option
cases.script: shopt -s nosuchopt; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: test string operators
cases.script: test -z '' && echo z; test -n x && echo n; [ a = a ] && echo eq; [ a != b ] && echo ne; [ a \< b ] && echo lt; [ b \> a ] && echo gt

cases.name: builtin: test numeric operators
cases.script: [ 2 -eq 2 ] && [ 1 -lt 2 ] && [ 3 -ge 3 ] && [ 4 -ne 5 ] && echo ok; [ 1 -eq x ]; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: test file operators
cases.script: cd /tmp; : >e; echo x >s; mkdir -p d; ln -sf s l; for f in e s d l nope; do printf '%s:' $f; [ -e $f ] && printf e; [ -f $f ] && printf f; [ -d $f ] && printf d; [ "$f" != d ] && [ -s $f ] && printf s; [ -L $f ] && printf L; echo; done

cases.name: builtin: test combined and negated
cases.script: [ ! -e /nope ] && echo absent; [ 1 -eq 1 -a 2 -eq 2 ] && echo and; [ 1 -eq 2 -o 2 -eq 2 ] && echo or; [ \( 1 -eq 1 \) ] && echo group

cases.name: builtin: test syntax errors
cases.script: [ 1 -eq ]; echo status=$?; [ a b c ]; echo status=$?; test; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: test newer and older
cases.script: cd /tmp; touch -d '2020-01-01' old; touch -d '2021-01-01' new; [ new -nt old ] && echo nt; [ old -ot new ] && echo ot; [ old -ef old ] && echo ef

cases.name: builtin: unset variables and functions
cases.script: x=1; f() { :; }; unset x; echo "[${x-unset}]"; unset -f f; f 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?; unset -v nosuch; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: return outside a function
cases.script: return 3; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: return statuses
cases.script: f() { return 7; }; f; echo $?; g() { false; return; }; g; echo $?; h() { return 300; }; h; echo $?

cases.name: builtin: exit status wraps
cases.script: (exit 256); echo $?; (exit -1); echo $?

cases.name: builtin: exec a command ends the script
cases.script: echo before; exec echo replaced; echo not-reached

cases.name: builtin: exec with no command keeps going
cases.script: exec 3>/tmp/x; echo kept >&3; exec 3>&-; cat /tmp/x

cases.name: builtin: colon true false
cases.script: : ignored args; echo $?; true; echo $?; false; echo $?

cases.name: builtin: jobs listing forms
cases.script: sleep 0.1 & jobs >/dev/null; echo status=$?; jobs -l | wc -l; wait

cases.name: builtin: kill -l
cases.script: kill -l 15; kill -l TERM; kill -l 999; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: compgen word lists
cases.script: compgen -W 'alpha beta alps' al; compgen -W 'x y' z; echo status=$?

cases.name: builtin: compgen variables
cases.script: myvar1=1 myvar2=2; compgen -v myvar
